The Reconstituted Arcanist is a skeleton creature in Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

A Reconstituted Arcanist is in the Mind Flayer Colony in Act Two. It is accompanied by a  Death Shepherd and potentially  Balthazar.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Rusty Dagger
Damage: 1~4
1d4⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Withering Gift ()

Give your  Withering Life Force to another creature.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Withering Theft ()
Damage: 2~16
2d8⁠Necrotic
Rob a creature of its life force and gain 20 temporary hit points.
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)

Loot

  • Rusty Dagger

Notes

  • The Reconstituted Arcanist does not yield experience.[verify]
